recipe.title: Cranberry, chocolate and pumpkin seed cookies

method.s: Beat butter and peanut butter together. Beat in sugar, then egg and vanilla essence.
Sift in flour and baking soda. Mix in rolled oats, chocolate, pumpkin seeds and cranberries.
Roll mixture into two-tablespoon balls and place on an oven tray lined with baking paper. Press tops of biscuits with a fork.
Bake for 10-12 minutes. Leave to cool on a wire rack.
